provenance.author: Dr. B.V. Raman
provenance.time_reliability: Published by Raman in Chapter 35 as 2:51 AM LMT. Bengali family records (Thakur Bari diary) record 21 danda 45 pal after sunset (~2:38 AM LMT). Web aggregators previously cited 4:02 AM without historical provenance. Unsuitable for reliable birth-time/Lagna-dependent benchmarks; retained solely for time-independent planetary conjunction analysis (Sun & Mercury in Aries).

budhaditya_yoga.notes: Sun and Mercury both occupy Aries throughout the entire civil day of May 7, 1861. Budhaditya Yoga is independently derived from planetary coordinates (invariant to birth-time variation within May 7, 1861).

lagna_dependent_yogas.notes: Lagna-dependent yogas and house assignments are classified as Category C (unreliable / unsuitable) due to historical discrepancies between 2:38 AM, 2:51 AM, and 4:02 AM.
